landing.heroDescription: Expenses, budgets, wealth tracking, and bill splitting. Without the bloat.
landing.overviewDescription: Real-time spending stats, budget pacing, category breakdowns, and recent activity. All on one screen.
landing.budgetDescription: Allocate budgets across categories and track spending progress in real time.
landing.splittingDescription: Split with anyone, no account required. One balance per person across all your shared expenses.
landing.wealthDescription: Track your net worth, assets, liabilities, and financial runway over time.
landing.moreSubtitle: Built for people who want full control over their financial data.
landing.tryForFreeDescription: A free hosted instance is available. Sign up and start tracking in minutes, no credit card needed.
landing.openSourceDescription: Retrospend is fully open source. Self-host it and your financial data never leaves your server. No vendor lock-in, no tracking.

multiCurrency.title: Multi-Currency, Done Right
multiCurrency.description: Log expenses in any currency, crypto included. Parallel market rates like Argentina's blue dollar or Bolivia's parallel rate are supported. You pick the rate that applies.

bankImport.title: Bank Import
bankImport.description: Drop in a CSV, PDF, or XLSX from your bank. AI handles the parsing and categorization.

privacyMode.title: Privacy Mode
privacyMode.description: One toggle hides all amounts. Good for reviewing finances without flashing numbers in public.

budgetPacing.title: Budget Pacing
budgetPacing.description: Know your daily safe-to-spend the moment you open the app.

recurringExpenses.title: Recurring Expenses
recurringExpenses.description: Set up templates for subscriptions and bills. Retrospend generates them on schedule so you never forget to log one.

wealthTracking.title: Wealth Tracking
wealthTracking.description: Track assets, liabilities, and net worth over time. See your financial runway at a glance.

landing.ctaDescription: Track spending, split bills, manage budgets, and watch your net worth grow.
landing.diffOneBalanceDesc: All debts with someone collapse into a single number. Split across trips, share a one-off dinner, settle when you want. No per-group accounting.
landing.diffNoAccountDesc: Send a magic link. They join with a name and email. No download, no password. If they sign up later, their history carries over.
landing.diffProjectsDesc: Trips, roommates, group gifts, recurring costs. Five types with budgets, billing periods, and activity feeds. Or skip the project and split directly.
landing.diffPaymentMethodsDesc: Venmo, PayPal, Zelle, PIX, MercadoPago, crypto wallets, bank transfers. Shows methods you both use and generates deep links with the amount pre-filled.
landing.demoBudgetVariableDesc: Categories you actively monitor and adjust
landing.demoBudgetFixedDesc: Categories that automatically match your actual spending
